newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan police fire in air to disperse protest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan police fire in air to disperse protest.

text.p: Pakistani police fired shots in the air on Monday to break up a big opposition march in Lahore after protesters hurled stones at the Punjab provincial assembly building, witnesses said.
Up to 40,000 people joined the march staged by 14 opposition parties campaigning against Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto in central Lahore, capital of populous Punjab province.
Towards the end of the protest, some marchers hurled stones at the assembly building and ransacked the office of the assembly security officer, witnesses said.
They said police first fired teargas canisters and then shots in the air to disperse the stone-throwing crowd.
